{{Quote|My friends, allow me to introduce the Diplomatic Service's allies on Nar Shaddaa--the Shadow Syndicate.|Maro Vizhen introduces the Shadow Syndicate leaders to Imperial heroes on Nar Shaddaa|<ref name="ACB" />}}
The '''Shadow Syndicate''' was a criminal organization led by [[Godoba]] the Hutt, the owner of the [[Club Vertica Casino]], [[Vaarko Tiyai]], the [[Cho'mash]] of the [[Nar Shaddaa Labor Alliance]], and [[DX-TX]], the primary hub of the [[DX annihilator network]]. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Maro Vizhen]] of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] was responsible for gathering these three notorious criminals and making them allies for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Ukabi]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] leader of the [[Exchange]], refused to join the Syndicate.

==History==
===Ukabi incident===
{{GameDSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
{{Quote|Together, they represent key powers. Ukabi and the Exchange could've joined them--but thanks to your strike, we needn't worry about the Exchange anymore.|Maro Vizhen describes the Shadow Syndicate to Imperial heroes|<ref name="ACB" />}}
[[File:Ukabi.png|thumb|right|250px|Nar Shaddaa Exchange leader Ukabi (pictured) was asked to join the syndicate and ally with the empire but refused.]]
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the Shadow Syndicate had allied itself with the empire on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the syndicate leaders rebuked [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] [[Special Operations (Diplomatic Service)|Special Operations]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Maro Vizhen]], the empire's liaison to the syndicate, for directing four Imperial heroes<ref name="Heroes">Throughout this article, the term "Imperial heroes" is used to signify the four playable character classes of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] faction in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. This includes the [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]], [[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]], [[Cipher Nine|Imperial Agent]], and [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter]].</ref> to cripple the operations of [[Ukabi]], the local leader of the [[Exchange]], in the moon's [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]] for refusing to join the syndicate and align with the empire, citing Ukabi's consistent history of brutal retaliation for such acts.<ref name="ACB" />

While Ukabi initiated a retaliatory strike against syndicate assets and civilians, the Imperial heroes struck Ukabi's chemical enhancement facilities, defeating four super soldier prototypes<ref name="TEEF">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|The Exchange Enhancement Facility|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> and four other enhanced soldiers.<ref name="StES">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Slay the Enhanced Soldiers|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> Despite the success of the attack, syndicate leader [[Godoba]] continued to plead with Ukabi to reestablish peaceful relations and blamed Vizhen for the deteriorating business relationship between the syndicate and Exchange. Vizhen resolved to remedy the situation by deploying the Imperial heroes to the Exchange's base and assassinating Ukabi and his inner circle.<ref name="TEEF" />

The heroes struck at Ukabi's headquarters, defeating at least ten of his gang members<ref name="TFA">{{TORcite|type=bonus|The Final Assault|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> and four of his lieutenants. Upon entering Ukabi's personal chambers, they found the room empty and received a distress call from Vizhen who said they'd been betrayed and that Ukabi was attacking her [[Shadow Syndicate safe house|command post]]. The heroes returned to the syndicate safe house where it was revealed that Godoba had betrayed the alliance by entering into a deal with Ukabi to kill Vizhen. After the heroes defeated Ukabi, the syndicate leaders suggested the heroes kill Vizhen, whose decisions had been hurting their businesses. The heroes eliminated Vizhen to appease the syndicate leaders, who promised to pursue a fruitful partnership with the empire.<ref name="TAtF">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|Tearing Apart the Foe|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

===Aiding the empire===
{{Quote|The Shadow Syndicate is at your command. Along with Imperial Intelligence, we're here to support your campaign against the Republic. The Empire has many enemies. We'll ensure they fail.|Shadow Syndicate agent Narvusin to Imperial heroes on Nar Shaddaa|<ref name="StP">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|Shattering the Peace|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>}}
[[File:Transit Bridge.png|thumb|left|250px|Shadow Syndicate personnel converged on a transit bridge (pictured) in Nar Shaddaa's Network Security District to assist the empire with follow-up missions against the republic.]]
The [[3642 BBY|following year]],<ref name="3642BBY">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> Godoba alerted the empire to the presence of a [[Republic Research Division|research complex]] on Nar Shaddaa where the Republic was developing advanced battlefield technologies. To aid the empire in eliminating this threat, Godoba arranged for a communications blackout to prevent Republic personnel from calling for aid.<ref name="SM">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|Smuggler's Moon|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

After the Imperial heroes performed several missions to deprive the Republic of their technological advantage, [[DX-AX]] of the Shadow Syndicate informed them that despite their successful assault on the research complex, the Republic was engaged in other activities on the moon and would recover from the damage inflicted on their operations within a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. Shadow Syndicate agents<ref name="SSA">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Shadow Syndicate Agent|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> and [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]]<ref name="SSS">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Shadow Syndicate Slicer|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> joined with [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] personnel and assembled on a [[Transit bridge|transit bridge]] in the moon's [[Network Security District]] to conduct follow-up missions against the Republic. On the bridge, Shadow Syndicate agent [[Narvusin]] coordinated the syndicate's efforts to support the empire.<ref name="StP" />

Once the operations were concluded, Godoba presented the heroes a "gift" to strengthen the alliance between the syndicate and empire. In response to the damage inflicted on their operations, the Republic was evacuating the families of their researchers and [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] on the moon via a single [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. The Shadow Syndicate was in a position to discreetly destroy the transport with the intended effect of discouraging the Republic from sending additional personnel to the moon. The heroes accepted Godoba's offer and an unmarked syndicate [[Warship/Legends|warship]] successfully destroyed the transport with the families aboard.<ref name="StP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shadow Syndicate first appeared in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]]. All four Imperial player character classes first encounter the organization at the end of the mission A Crushing Blow, the first mission of the Nar Shaddaa planetary story arc for Imperial characters.<ref name="ACB" /> Imperial player characters encountered the syndicate again in the Nar Shaddaa bonus planetary story.<ref name="StP" />

===Alternate stories===
{{Quote|Kill her. Let business proceed, let a smarter girl take her place--and the Shadow Syndicate will reward you. Our wealth and power... yours!|Godoba the Hutt entices the Imperial heroes to kill Vizhen to improve relations between the syndicate and empire|<ref name="TAtF" />}}
At the end of the mission A Crushing Blow, player characters had the dark side option to target Ukabi's enhancement facilities while his death squads were engaged targeting civilians, or the light side option of intercepting the death squads.<ref name="ACB" /> The player's decision determined which succeeding mission was assigned, targeting either the Exchange enhancement facility<ref name="TEEF" /> or death squads.<ref name="TEDS">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|The Exchange Death Squad|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

At the end of the mission Tearing Apart the Foe, player characters could select the light side option of allowing Vizhen to live.<ref name="TAtF" />

At the end of the Nar Shaddaa planetary bonus story arc, Imperial characters could choose the light side option of refusing the Shadow Syndicate's offer to destroy the transport evacuating Republic families.<ref name="StP" />
